title: Coverage-Loss Allowance on Patient Financial Assistance Program Document Extensions
content:
When the documents due date of a Patient Financial Assistance Program case is extended, a coverage-loss allowance is added to the extension's days before they are counted. It is counted in calendar days from the day the household's ended coverage ended to today. An ended coverage is a coverage in terminated status in Insurance Coverage & Claims, and the day it ended is its termination date.

## Band schedule

| Calendar days from the coverage's termination date to today | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| No more than 120 | 3 days |
| More than 120, no more than 365 | 1 day |
| More than 365 | None |
| No ended coverage on file | None |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical; today 15 September 2026)

| Coverage terminated on | Days to today | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 18 May 2026 | 120 | 3 days |
| 17 May 2026 | 121 | 1 day |
| 15 September 2025 | 365 | 1 day |
| 14 September 2025 | 366 | None |
